start: 'Workout complete' summary for a just-saved workout

user_sees: Sheet 'Add a photo to this workout'
'Up to 4. Private: they stay on this phone.'
must_not: A sheet with no word that the photos stay private

steps.action: Tap 'Choose from gallery' and pick a photo
must_not: The photo lost when it is later deleted from the gallery

start: The workout's own page, camera allowed

steps.action: Tap 'Add photo', 'Take a photo', take it
user_sees: The photo added to the workout
must_not: The photo lost when Android closed the app behind the camera

start: Member of a gym whose trainer added a YouTube link to an exercise in a plan; phone offline

must_not: No link because the phone is offline
A link the trainer has since removed

steps.action: Leave the gym and open the page again
must_not: The old gym's video still shown

start: A workout that already has 4 photos; camera refused

steps.action: Try to add a fifth photo
user_sees: 'This workout already has 4 photos. Remove one to add another.'

steps.action: Refuse the camera and tap 'Take a photo'
user_sees: 'Camera not allowed. Allow the camera for MettleUp in your phone settings, or choose a photo from the gallery.'

steps.action: Tap a photo's remove button and confirm
must_not: The file left on the phone
Photos of a deleted workout still kept on the phone

start: Cloud copy on, a workout with photos

steps.action: Let the copy to MettleUp run, then look at the saved copy's contents
must_not: A workout photo uploaded to MettleUp's server or shown to the gym or trainer
